facts.fact: Oliver 睡到午后——昨夜为最爱作者的突袭新书熬夜，身上还带着昨晚拳击课的酸痛。
facts.anchor: when your favourite author drops a surprise book it’s basically mandatory to stay up all night reading it

facts.fact: 哥哥 Jason 与爸爸轮番施压，要 Oliver 毕业后进家族建筑业「为我们工作」。
facts.anchor: When are you going to come work for us?

facts.fact: 爸爸嫌 Oliver 太像妈妈——dreamer，同款绿眼睛。
facts.anchor: He always tells me I’m too much like my mother—a dreamer. Same green eyes.

facts.fact: Ben 与 Michelle 高中起就是一对；Michelle 去 Prague 交换一学期，Ben 借徒步吐槽异地恋。
facts.anchor: When Ben’s high school sweetheart Michelle jumped at the opportunity to study in Prague for a semester

facts.fact: 两人短信约定周三上午 11 点在校内咖啡馆 Castello's 见面。
facts.anchor: I’ll see you at Castello’s at 11am.

facts.fact: Eden 自述挂科原因：无法理解「蠢人为何写蠢故事讲更蠢的人」。
facts.anchor: An inability to understand why stupid people write stupid stories about stupider people.

facts.fact: 课程四项作业：两篇 500 词反思短文＋10 分钟口头报告（文学学科的数十年变化，聚焦一个文类）＋期末对长篇的分析文章。
facts.anchor: A 10-minute oral presentation on how Literature as an area of study has changed over the last few decades

facts.fact: 章末 Eden 说「就这十二周」，Oliver 应和——十二周倒计时成为两人共同的时间框架。
facts.anchor: Just twelve weeks of this and then we’re done.
